title: Find an OTA, suspend and resume it
caption: Needs an active OTA (OTA worker running). Mirrors admin-tenant-lifecycle.e2e.ts and admin-suspension-storefront.e2e.ts.

steps.title: Find the OTA
steps.body: Type part of the key, the name or an owner's **whole** e-mail in **Search** and press Search.
steps.expect: The URL keeps `q`; one row with status Active; click the OTA name.

steps.title: Suspend
steps.body: **Suspend** → choose **Kind of suspension** (abuse, request, admin; 'Velexis decision' preselected) → **Reason** (5-500) → **Suspend OTA**.
steps.expect: Status 'The OTA is suspended.' with a Suspension job link; only **Resume** is offered now.

steps.title: Check the effects
steps.body: Open the job link; open Mailpit; open the storefront and the owner's portal page.
steps.expect: Job 'Done' after the OTA worker answers; e-mail '<name> has been suspended'; the storefront says 'temporarily unavailable' within 60 s; the portal shows 'This OTA is suspended'.

steps.title: Resume
steps.expect: 'The OTA is active again.' with a Resumption job; e-mail '<name> is active again'; storefront works again within 60 s.

steps.title: Audit
steps.expect: Rows `tenant.suspended` and `tenant.resumed`, actor 'Platform admin' with your e-mail and both reasons.
